title: Cosine Matching and Ranking
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of similarity scores and candidate ordering, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in resume-screening-and-jd-matching.
learning_objectives: Explain similarity scores and candidate ordering in plain language and connect it to src/matcher.py; src/embedder.py.
Trace one input through the cosine matching and ranking stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the cosine matching and ranking stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for similarity scores and candidate ordering.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
